SBI Chairman Urges AI Expansion to Rural India for Banking Success

State Bank of India Chairman Dinesh Kumar Khara has emphasized the need to extend Artificial Intelligence (AI) in banking services to rural India. He stated that achieving true success in banking, particularly in the context of developing India by 2047, requires AI's reach into villages. This expansion is seen as crucial for financial inclusion and the overall progress of the nation's banking sector.
